title: Orsen and the Recipe
premise: Isandro Thackeray, a seventeen-year-old coder who runs an anonymous exposé account about Hollowmere Academy, starts receiving handwritten notes from the school's legendary ghost — notes that name them, know their secrets, and appear in ink that shouldn't exist. Following the ghost's clues, Isandro and their best friend-turned-crush Priya uncover that the school board buried a fatal lab accident decades ago and has been quietly erasing the victim's name ever since; the ghost is the victim's sister, kept half-alive by the school's own founding ritual. At prom, Isandro must choose between publishing the truth (which will destroy the scholarship program they depend on) or staying silent to protect their future — and they choose truth, breaking the ritual's hold, freeing the ghost, and forcing the board's resignation as Isandro finally signs their real name to their work.
about_author: Wren Underhill is the pen name of a former boarding-school archivist who spent years cataloguing letters no one claimed. They write stories about kids who find the cracks in institutions and decide to pry them open.

chapters.title: The Account That Knew Too Much
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. We meet Hollowmere Academy through Isandro's double life: model student by day, anonymous whistleblower @hollowtruths by night. A post about missing scholarship funds goes viral, and Headmistress Vane announces an 'internal review.' Isandro is fine. Everything is fine. Beat: anxious bravado masking fear of exposure.

chapters.title: Ink That Shouldn't Exist
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. A note appears inside Isandro's locked locker: 'You're close, Thackeray. Dig at the 1974 wing.' The handwriting matches samples from the school's ghost legend, and the ink shifts color under lamplight. Security footage shows no one. Beat: eerie wonder cracking into genuine dread.

chapters.title: Priya Knows
chapters.summary: POV Priya. Priya, editor of the school paper and Isandro's closest friend, reveals she's been receiving notes too — ones quoting her late mother's letters. She confronts Isandro about suspecting @hollowtruths is theirs. Beat: betrayal curdling into reluctant alliance, with unspoken feelings underneath.

chapters.title: The 1974 Wing
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. The pair break into the sealed science wing and find a bricked-over lab, scorched floor tiles, and a memorial plaque with the name scratched out. The ghost appears briefly — a girl in an old uniform who mouths 'her name was Rosalind.' Beat: awe and grief; the mystery becomes personal.

chapters.title: Board Minutes and Buried Names
chapters.summary: POV Priya. In the archives, Priya decodes redacted board minutes: a student named Rosalind Okonkwo died in a lab fire, and the board covered it up to protect a donor family — the same family funding Isandro's scholarship. Vane nearly catches them. Beat: righteous anger meeting cold institutional power.

chapters.title: What Loyalty Costs
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. Vane privately offers Isandro a full-ride extension and a glowing recommendation — if the account goes quiet and the archives stay closed. Isandro's family needs it. Meanwhile the ghost's notes turn desperate: 'Prom night. Before the candles burn out.' Beat: the trap of duty tightening around love and loyalty.

chapters.title: The Recipe
chapters.summary: POV Priya. The title drops: among Rosalind's effects is a 'recipe' — the alchemical formula the founders used to bind her spirit to the school, renewed every prom by candlelight so she can never testify, never rest, never be remembered. Priya realizes destroying it frees the ghost but ends the school's charter luck. Beat: terrible clarity.

chapters.title: Everything Is Not Fine
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. Vane discovers Isandro is @hollowtruths and threatens expulsion and scholarship revocation unless they hand over the recipe pages. Isandro almost breaks — then finds the ghost waiting in their room, showing them the last moments of Rosalind's life. Beat: rock bottom, and the choice crystallizing.

chapters.title: Prom Night, Burning Candles
chapters.summary: POV alternating Isandro/Priya. At prom, mid-renewal ceremony, Isandro takes the stage, outs themselves as @hollowtruths, and reads Rosalind's name aloud while Priya burns the recipe before the board. The ghost blazes into visibility before the whole school — seen, witnessed, finally free. Beat: triumphant, terrifying climax.

chapters.title: Signed, Isandro Thackeray
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. Aftermath: the board resigns, the scholarship is rebuilt on honest terms, and Rosalind's restored plaque anchors a new memorial garden. Isandro publishes one final post under their real name. On the windowsill, a last note in ordinary, fading ink: 'Thank you.' Beat: quiet, earned peace.
